customer.business: Nota (@NotaGetBot): a Telegram bot that collects receipts, invoices and handwritten delivery notes from work chats into the owner's Google Sheet and flags duplicates and arithmetic errors
customer.target: Owners of small businesses in Bali (5–50 people, no finance department) whose staff spend money on site and send receipts to Telegram work groups
customer.where: Bali, Indonesia (Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu, Denpasar); Russian-speaking and international owners with local Indonesian staff

segments.name: Villa management company or villa rental operator
Remote investor in villas or a build, living abroad

behaviours.name: Runs everything through chats
behaviours.how: Receipts pile up in Telegram groups; nobody records them regularly; you check when something feels off.

behaviours.name: Has an admin with Excel
behaviours.how: An admin or manager types receipts into a spreadsheet once a week; it is always behind.

behaviours.name: Already uses an app
behaviours.how: You or your bookkeeper use Jurnal, Zoho Expense or a similar app and are reasonably happy with it.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: You have caught a staff member or contractor double-claiming or inflating receipts and now check closely.

behaviours.name: Price-sensitive
behaviours.how: Every subscription is questioned; you prefer free tools and cancel what you do not use weekly.

behaviours.name: Privacy-wary
behaviours.how: You do not like giving bots access to your Google account or your work chats.

behaviours.name: Tech-savvy DIY
behaviours.how: You or a friend could build a bot with n8n or ChatGPT and you know it.

behaviours.name: Delegates to a bookkeeper
behaviours.how: An outside bookkeeper handles documents monthly; you rarely look at receipts yourself.

objections: I already have a free option: Zoho, KasKecil, Excel or a bot I could build myself
Will it really catch a duplicate, or is it just a receipt-to-table bot?
I do not want to give a bot access to my Google account and work chats
Recognition will make mistakes on faded or handwritten Indonesian receipts and I will have to fix it
My staff and I are not sure we will keep using it after the free part
$19 a month for something my admin already does
If I find a duplicate, it is a people problem, not a software problem
Will a new small product still be around in a year?
habits: you have 2–4 Telegram work groups where receipts and transfer screenshots land every day
you live in Bali part of the year and manage from abroad the rest
your Indonesian staff write handwritten nota from the building-supply shop
your accountant asks for documents at month end and half are missing
you pay contractors by bank transfer and send screenshots to the group
you check the group chat late at night to see what was spent
you share monthly spending with a partner or investor
you buy spare parts, fuel and repairs for a fleet of rental scooters and pay mechanics in cash

pitch:
Nota (@NotaGetBot) — a Telegram bot that keeps your business expenses under control.
Add it to the work chat where your staff already send receipts, or forward documents to it privately. Staff change nothing and install nothing.
It reads receipts, invoices, PDFs, bank-transfer screenshots and handwritten nota in any language, checks the line items against the total, catches duplicates even when a receipt is re-photographed or sent again by someone else, and writes each document as a row in your own Google Sheet with a link to the original. Every Monday you get a weekly spending report you can forward to a partner.
Setup takes one minute (sign in with Google; the sheet and files stay in your Google Drive). Up to 5 groups per account.
First 40 documents free (20 of them can be your old chat history uploaded as an archive). Then $19/month for 100 documents, $45 for 300, $119 for 1,000.
